info.name: MiComm - Multi-channel send
info.description:
Send one message on several channels (EMAIL, SMS, WHATSAPP) to several recipients.

Run '1. Login' first: it saves the access token into the collection variable 'token', which '2. Send notification' uses.

Every requested channel needs an active provider account for the club + product (club_product_providers), otherwise the send is rejected.

variable.description: Portal user's password; set as a current value, don't save it in the collection

header.description: New key per click; reuse a fixed key to test replay (response header Idempotent-Replayed: true)
Alternative to the Bearer token: a club API key
